name: Claire Loughran
title: Registered Psychologist
description: She draws on different evidence-based interventions to tailor her sessions to the individual needs of her clients, including Person-Centred Counselling, CBT, ACT, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) Therapy, as well as Eating Disorder Interventions (Enhanced-CBT and Family Based Therapy). Claire has completed additional training to work with young people and adults experiencing eating disorders, disordered eating, and body image concerns.
specialties: EMDR, eating disorders, body image, trauma
